events.verdict: Williams (UTA) engages with Adebayo (MIA), but the contact during rebounding is marginal.
Williams (UTA) keeps an arm wrapped around Adebayo (MIA) and the contact during his shot attempt is more than marginal.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) and Bailey (UTA) both firmly have their hands on the ball and the contact between the two players is incidental.
Filipowski (UTA) legally contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt and Adebayo loses his balance on his own upon returning to the floor.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) begins to lose his balance after incidental foot to foot contact with Sensabaugh (UTA). Sensabaugh places his off-arm against Jaquez Jr. and releases away as he steps back.
Bailey (UTA) legally contests Wiggins' (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Collier (UTA) places his off-arm against Jakucionis (MIA) and releases away as he steps back.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes a screening position in Collier's (UTA) path and does not deliver contact.
Collier (UTA) legally contests Jakucionis' (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) commits a take foul on Sensabaugh (UTA).
Filipowski (UTA) and Collier (UTA) inadvertently run into each other during the throw-in.
Mitchell (MIA) commits a take foul on Sensabaugh (UTA).
